g.title: crate Arvane render: rasterises RenderScene into CPU pixmaps and GPU textures.
crate::convert Conversion of portable scene types into private rasterizer types.
crate::cpu CpuRaster: rasterizes validated scenes with vello_cpu on the calling thread.
crate::derived Pixels derived from a scene's values and kept from one frame to the next.
crate::draw Drawing of a scene's commands, shared by the CPU and the GPU rasterizers.
crate::draw::canvas Canvas: the calls both rasterizers receive, and the glyph runs they draw.
crate::draw::painter Records a scene's commands in order through a Canvas, tracking open groups.
crate::draw::shadows Box shadows drawn with what both rasterizers have.
crate::gpu GPU rasterizer: draws scenes into the textures a caller gives it.
crate::gpu::encode Encoding of Arvane scenes into vello_hybrid scenes for the GPU rasterizer.
crate::gpu::images The GPU renderer's image textures and pattern atlas slots.
crate::gpu::raster GPU rasterizer state: the renderer, its resources and the frame drawn.
crate::gradient Converts gradient paints without renderer cache state.
crate::images Converted images kept from one frame to the next.
crate::ink The ink of a glyph run: the box its glyphs' outlines cover.
crate::limits Passive scene validation and frame budget constants.
crate::outline The outlines of a glyph run as path commands, for strokes and pattern fills.
crate::paint Conversion of paints into rasterizer brushes for the CPU and the GPU.
crate::text How glyphs are rasterized, the same on the CPU and the GPU.
crate::validate Validate scene data before rasterization.
crate::validate::fonts Bounded successful font metadata with allocation lifetime protection.
crate::validate::frame Decides a frame's pixel dimensions and raster scale within the frame budget.
crate::validate::scene Checks every command of a scene before anything is drawn.
